Text.Text: The rite can be practiced freely again. Keep the bond a choice for both of you. You've finished my Force-Bonded Beast trials. I have no further work for you here.
You need rank 50 in Beast Mastery for this rite. Train your own handling skill, then return. A strong bond begins with a responsible handler.

Handlers in the den are teaching bonds through force and fear. Recover the trail slate they use for their rites. Defeat six Force-Bonded Beast Adepts in Dathomir, Grotto Apex Den. Their defeat secures the Force-Bonded Beast Grotto Track Slate; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Waterfall Ruins. I'll give you the Dathomir Grotto Apex Den Key when you accept. Complete all five trials to earn the right to train Force-Bonded Beast.

Here's the Dathomir Grotto Apex Den Key. Use 'Enter the Grotto Apex Den' in Dathomir, Grotto Caverns. My key grants access. Keep your party close to the entrance when you use it so they can enter with you. Defeat six Force-Bonded Beast Adepts, then return with the Force-Bonded Beast Grotto Track Slate.

A true bond is spoken, not forced. Thread laid between two willing lives, tightened by trust instead of chain. The den's keepers found the old rite and cut the willing part out of it entirely. What is left, they teach the adepts. It is not binding. It is leashing with extra words.

In the old rite, the slate marked where the ground itself remembered a bond made honestly, a place returned to, generation after generation. The adepts use it now to find beasts still uncorrupted, so they can corrupt them first. Bring it back and the ground remembers correctly again.

Because a forced bond always turns, eventually, and they know it. Better to sever a thread themselves than let it snap back on them later. That is the whole of their doctrine: control the ending, since they cannot control the truth of the beginning.
Defeat six Force-Bonded Beast Adepts in Dathomir, Grotto Apex Den. Their defeat secures the Force-Bonded Beast Grotto Track Slate; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Waterfall Ruins.
You've defeated six Force-Bonded Beast Adepts. Let me see the Force-Bonded Beast Grotto Track Slate.
That's the record I needed. We can account for the trails again. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the specialist trial when you're ready.

The specialists use a fang charm to sustain those forced bonds. Bring it home. Defeat five Force-Bonded Beast Specialists in Dathomir, Grotto Apex Den. Their defeat secures the Force-Bonded Beast Resonant Fang Charm; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Waterfall Ruins.
Your key still grants access to Dathomir, Grotto Apex Den. Defeat five Force-Bonded Beast Specialists to secure the Force-Bonded Beast Resonant Fang Charm, then return to me.

The fang charm once marked a bond strong enough to hum on its own, no rite needed to prove it. The specialists wear it stolen, to borrow a hum they never earned. Take it back and the hum means something again.

Force a bond, and somewhere under the obedience the beast is still choosing, every single day, not to break your neck. That choice does not vanish. It waits. A forced bond is a debt that always comes due, usually at the worst possible moment for whoever forced it.

They starve the beast of the choice entirely, goad and reward until there is no space left to choose anything else. It looks like loyalty. It is closer to drowning slowly enough that the beast forgets water used to feel different.
Defeat five Force-Bonded Beast Specialists in Dathomir, Grotto Apex Den. Their defeat secures the Force-Bonded Beast Resonant Fang Charm; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Waterfall Ruins.
You've defeated five Force-Bonded Beast Specialists. Let me see the Force-Bonded Beast Resonant Fang Charm.
This belongs with the handlers who know how to use it. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the warden trial when you're ready.

The warden carries an apex totem from the old rite. Defeat him and recover it. Defeat the Force-Bonded Beast Warden in Dathomir, Grotto Apex Den. Their defeat secures the Force-Bonded Beast Cracked Apex Totem; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Waterfall Ruins. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Dathomir, Grotto Apex Den, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Force-Bonded Beast Warden. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. After the fight, return with the Force-Bonded Beast Cracked Apex Totem.
Forced so long the beast inside it has forgotten it was ever asked. I do not know if there is anything left in there to save. That is not pity talking. It is the truest answer I have.

The cracked apex totem once marked the den's oldest honest bond, the first thread the rite was ever spoken over. He wears it broken because he broke that thread himself, the day forcing became easier than asking. Bring it back whole and the first bond is honored again, even after everything.

Yes. I recommend two companions for the Force-Bonded Beast Warden fight. That's advice for a dangerous encounter, not an entry requirement. Gather your party before calling the challenge; a second pair of hands can keep a bad opening from ending the fight.

Defeat the Force-Bonded Beast Warden in Dathomir, Grotto Apex Den. Their defeat secures the Force-Bonded Beast Cracked Apex Totem; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Waterfall Ruins. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Force-Bonded Beast Warden. Let me see the Force-Bonded Beast Cracked Apex Totem.
The totem is back in our keeping. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the inner circle trial when you're ready.

Four keepers turned the binding rite into an excuse for cruelty. Take back the den-mother's token. Defeat four members of the Force-Bonded Beast Inner Circle in Dathomir, Grotto Apex Den. Their defeat secures the Force-Bonded Beast Den-Mother's Fang Token; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Waterfall Ruins.
Your key still grants access to Dathomir, Grotto Apex Den. Defeat four members of the Force-Bonded Beast Inner Circle to secure the Force-Bonded Beast Den-Mother's Fang Token, then return to me.

Every corruption I have named to you, they wrote down and taught as if it were the original rite. Force. Leash. Goad. Sever what turns on you first. Scripture is a powerful lie when the ones reading it never knew the true words to compare it against.

The den-mother's own bond, older than any of us, split four ways so no single keeper could ever claim the whole truth of her thread. Whole again, it is proof the true rite still exists somewhere underneath everything they built on top of it.

The rite, spoken honestly, over every beast still capable of choosing. Not leashed. Not goaded. Asked, the way it was always meant to be asked. I have waited a long time to speak it properly again. You are the reason I finally will.

Defeat four members of the Force-Bonded Beast Inner Circle in Dathomir, Grotto Apex Den. Their defeat secures the Force-Bonded Beast Den-Mother's Fang Token; bring it back to me here in Dathomir, Waterfall Ruins.
You've defeated four members of the Force-Bonded Beast Inner Circle. Let me see the Force-Bonded Beast Den-Mother's Fang Token.
The keepers can no longer claim authority here. Your payment is ready. Speak to me again for the final trial when you're ready.

Their master is the source of the forced binding. Defeat him in the Sealed Apex Den so the true rite can be restored. Defeat the Force-Bonded Beast Master in Dathomir, Sealed Apex Den. Report back to me here in Dathomir, Waterfall Ruins; no item is needed for this final trial. I recommend bringing two companions for this fight.

In Dathomir, Sealed Apex Den, use the '???' challenge marker to call the Force-Bonded Beast Master. Accept this assignment before using the marker. Bring two companions if you can. Once the master is defeated, come back for the final lesson.

A bond kept so long without consent that consent stopped mattering to it. His beast does not choose him anymore, not because it loves him too much to leave, but because the choosing itself was carved out long ago. What you have built with yours this whole trial, freely, both ways, he has the same shape of, forced. That is what you are ending.

Because his weave was built to answer a single pulling thread by simply consuming it, the way it has consumed every beast fed into it. Many threads, pulling together, from every side at once, and there is finally more to cut than his weave can absorb in a breath. Alone, you are just one more thread it swallows.

The rite goes back to being spoken, not forced. I will speak it honestly again, over every bond that still wants speaking. Whether the den itself heals is not mine to promise. That the rite survives, true, is.

Defeat the Force-Bonded Beast Master in Dathomir, Sealed Apex Den. Report back to me here in Dathomir, Waterfall Ruins; no item is needed for this final trial. Use the '???' challenge marker there to begin the fight. Two companions are recommended.
You've defeated the Force-Bonded Beast Master. Give me your report and we'll finish the trial.
The rite can be practiced freely again. Keep the bond a choice for both of you. You've earned the right to train Force-Bonded Beast. Your final payment is ready.
Back to the thread.
I'll defeat six Force-Bonded Beast Adepts.
What is this rite of binding?
What did the slate hold, once?
Why do the adepts sever threads?
Give us time.
Here's the Force-Bonded Beast Grotto Track Slate.
Back to the thread.
I'll defeat five Force-Bonded Beast Specialists.
What did the charm hold, in the old rite?
Why does a forced bond always turn?
What do the specialists actually do to the beasts?
The thread needs settling first.
Here's the Force-Bonded Beast Resonant Fang Charm.
Back to the thread.
I'll defeat the Force-Bonded Beast Warden.
What is his bond, now?
What did the totem mark, in the old rite?
Would you recommend bringing help?
Our bonds are not ready to share the work.
Here's the Force-Bonded Beast Cracked Apex Totem.
Back to the thread.
I'll defeat four members of the Force-Bonded Beast Inner Circle.
What did they braid into scripture?
What did the den-mother's token hold?
What will you restore, once the relics are whole?
Let the cord hold a little longer. We are not ready.
Here's the Force-Bonded Beast Den-Mother's Fang Token.
Back to the thread.
I'll face the Force-Bonded Beast Master and report back.
What has his bond become?
Why does it take all of us to break one bond?
What happens after, to the rite itself?
Not yet. Our threads need to be surer.
The Force-Bonded Beast Master is defeated. Here's my report.
